name: Peru (1821–1822)
description: Divided per saltire into red (top and bottom) and white (hoist and fly) triangles, charged at the centre with a laurel-wreathed oval showing a sun rising over mountains and the sea.
history: The first flag of independent Peru, decreed by José de San Martín in 1820 and used until 1822.

features.role: oval emblem of the sun rising over mountains and the sea
